entries.back_en: "The curse the Empire makes is like a black mist... And there's a lot of nasty stuff inside it, like specters and hauntings... Even the smallest exposure without protection is lethal!"
"We need to cross Chamba. Is there any way we can do that before the curse disappears?"
"Any exposure to the mist is dangerous... It can poison you, or do strange things to your mind... And sometimes it just kills you! No matter what you do, stay away from the mist!"
"This curse is pretty potent... Never seen one like it. I mean, we managed to clean up Synesta quickly!"
"What are we going to do with ourselves when we finish here?" "Well, they said if another war starts, they'll call us."

"Did you hear? They say there's a kind of fish-monster or something living deep in the city!" "Yeah, I've heard about it. What do you expect? That curse affects everything it touches-- I bet there's all kinds of strange stuff there!"
